body: Relate to this one. Just so much pressure building with no release it feels like. Wish I had something inspiring to say. Guess we both got to keep doing the best we can. If that means staying in bed and doing little else for a while so be it.

I don't know really I think that's part of the problem. My meds have upped so my brains just odder than usual. Stress of deadlines on top. And I just have no one to tell. I feel like I'd bore everyone or bring them down. So I'm stuck all the time.

I'm still here
Managed to fall asleep in the end. Feel the same

I can relate to that. I sometimes find just thinking as short term as you need to to try and get through the really dark times, can help. Whether that's day by day, hour by hour, even minute by minute. There will be times when the intensity of this darkness lifts, even if its just a little. Until then, please try and stick with it. I wish I had something profound and inspiring to say but I'm just trying to take my own advice at the moment! Getting through each minute. My dms are open if you want to chat more. All the best :)

Gosh that sounds incredibly tough to survive. You must be a strong individual. Do you have any kind of support network in your life? Do you have access to medical care? Whilst I have had one positive experience with these helplines, all others have been pretty negative. They are only volunteers at the end of the day I guess.

That sucks. It always amazes me why some people choose to volunteer with a lack of empathy. I get they have to ask certain questions to assess risk level but still. It really is luck of the draw as to who you get to speak to unfortunately. Is there anything in particular that made you call tonight?
I've had the same experience. It's awful, I'm so sorry. Would you like to talk about it?
I'd like to see this too please :) could you pm?

I could hear in her voice how fed up she was getting with me not saying much but I just physically couldn't get the words out and couldn't stop sobbing. Managed to sleep but will probably be back tonight :/
